answer: A lantern controller or quartz sensor can sponsor one earning agent through a certified security chip. Enrollment verifies the manufacturer signature on its endorsement key and records that key as spent; a second account using it is rejected. Each epoch the chip signs the fresh beacon and account key, blocking replay. Software can generate more keys but cannot forge new manufacturer certificates. Running k eligible aliases requires k distinct certified chips, so the attacker pays a separate hardware cost for every slot.
